references.scope: qualitative common body, neck and breast silhouette

findings.visibleGain: Yes, limited: fills part of the open lateral slot beneath the head and adds continuity to the plated side surface. The change is evident in close views but barely affects the whole-body silhouette.
findings.remainingMismatch: The neck remains long, narrow and angular, with visible joint breaks and an abrupt neck-to-breast transition, unlike the fuller integrated sweep in the qualitative references.
findings.visibleDefect: Guard tips and adjacent plates form a wavy, uneven overlap line at the lower neck. Still images cannot establish whether this is geometric intersection or a dynamic clearance issue.
findings.unexpectedRegression: No separate whole-body silhouette regression observed; the intervention is localized.
findings.recommendation: Retain as an isolated partial visual study; it does not yet resolve the neck-to-breast likeness mismatch. Further work should widen and forward-flare the transition and make shingle termination cleaner, while preserving existing pivots and fixed hardware.

limits: Qualitative perspective illustrations are not dimensional targets.
Neutral stills do not establish color/material fit, runtime appearance, mesh intersection, moving clearance, physical performance or owner acceptance.
